business_summary: GCT Semiconductor Holding, Inc., a fabless semiconductor company, designs, manufactures, and sells communication semiconductors for industrial, business-to-business, and consumer applications in the United States, Taiwan, China, Germany, and South Korea. The company offers wireless communication technologies, such as 5G/5.75G/4.5G/4G transceivers and modems; RF and modem chipsets based on fourth-generation (4G) long term evolution (LTE) technology, including 4G LTE, 4.5G LTE Advanced, and 4.75G LTE Advanced-Pro; baseband modem solutions, RF transceivers, and system-on-chip (SoC) solutions; and product design and support, warranty development, customer support, and technical support services. It also develops and sells cellular Internet of Things (IoT) chipsets for low-speed mobile networks, such as eMTC/NB-IOT/Sigfox, and other network protocols; and 5G NR chipsets and other 5G NR solutions. The company's products and solutions are used in portable wireless routers, indoor and outdoor fixed wireless routers, industrial machine-to-machine applications, smartphones, fixed wireless subscriber terminals, various communication modules and devices, and industrial products. It sells its products directly or indirectly through distributors to wireless operators, original equipment manufacturers (OEMs), and original design manufacturers (ODMs) in Taiwan, China, Korea, Japan, Europe, North America, and South America. GCT Semiconductor Holding, Inc. has strategic partnership with MaxLinear, Inc. to develop 5G fixed wireless access (FWA) gateways and converged gateways for consumer and enterprise applications. GCT Semiconductor Holding, Inc. was founded in 1998 and is headquartered in San Jose, California.
business_summary_ko: 팹리스 반도체 회사인 GCT Semiconductor Holding, Inc.는 미국, 대만, 중국, 독일 및 한국에서 산업용, B2B 및 소비자 애플리케이션용 통신 반도체를 설계, 제조 및 판매합니다. 이 회사는 5G/5.75G/4.5G/4G 송수신기 및 모뎀과 같은 무선 통신 기술을 제공합니다. 4G LTE, 4.5G LTE Advanced 및 4.75G LTE Advanced-Pro를 포함한 4세대(4G) Long Term Evolution(LTE) 기술을 기반으로 하는 RF 및 모뎀 칩셋 베이스밴드 모뎀 솔루션, RF 트랜시버 및 SoC(시스템 온 칩) 솔루션; 제품 설계 및 지원, 보증 개발, 고객 지원 및 기술 지원 서비스. 또한 eMTC/NB-IOT/Sigfox 및 기타 네트워크 프로토콜과 같은 저속 모바일 네트워크용 셀룰러 IoT(사물 인터넷) 칩셋을 개발 및 판매합니다. 5G NR 칩셋 및 기타 5G NR 솔루션. 회사의 제품과 솔루션은 휴대용 무선 라우터, 실내 및 실외 고정 무선 라우터, 산업용 M2M 애플리케이션, 스마트폰, 고정 무선 가입자 단말기, 다양한 통신 모듈 및 장치, 산업용 제품에 사용됩니다. 그것은 p를 판매한다
